verdict.rationale: Better Auth is an npm-installed library that you instantiate in your own app (`betterAuth({...})`) against your own SQLite, PostgreSQL or MySQL database. Community users independently confirm it is open source and that they own all their data in their own DB, so the core product is inherently self-hosted. Missing for 10: no first-party license or deployment/self-hosting documentation in the pack, and community reports that some features are enterprise-only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Better Auth requires a database to store user data. You can easily configure Better Auth to use SQLite, PostgreSQL, or MySQL, and more!
Your auth lives in code version controlled, type-safe, and reviewable in PRs.
You get all of your auth data in your own db in 1 cli command.
We have been using better-auth (open source) for a while
